user_directive: Extend the active Menschen A2 Verben no-per-edit-heavy-ZIP workflow to all active and future content workstreams, without deleting unique checkpoints or weakening official QA, recovery or final delivery.
precedence: Read PROJECT-BOOTSTRAP, resolve exact workstream authority, read project memory and workstream-specific contracts. This policy reduces WIP artifact churn only. Specialized frozen-baseline, runtime-currentness, source fidelity, stage acceptance, Git milestone sync, and final packaging rules take precedence where more specific.

content_domains: Menschen A1/A2/B1 verbs and lexical enrichment

working_method.authority: One authoritative current working data state per individual workstream, with canonical/projection files as required by the schema. Do not conflate a single working STATE with a forced single-file delivery.
working_method.edit: Apply confirmed changes directly to that stream's active editable source/working dataset. Stable IDs, exact source order, registered origin, course memberships, rich examples, aliases and provenance must be preserved.
working_method.qa: Validate changed items and affected dependencies as edits are made; run broad/systemic QA when recurring error families are found. Preserve independent expert review requirements and stage-specific full validation.
working_method.review: Record evidence and reviewer decisions without creating another large inherited full ZIP. Model QA is not equivalent to independent qualified expert review.
working_method.audit_trail: Record compact changed-item IDs, before/after hashes, evidence links, reviewer status, rejected candidates, impact scope and results in a small log/receipt.
working_method.duplication: Do not copy all historical archive members into every successor; maintain exact lineage by stable hashes/paths, immutable baseline and compact deltas where they are sufficient and reproducible.
working_method.staged_backup: At a meaningful validated milestone preserve an exact recoverable checkpoint (working snapshot or immutable parent plus verified deltas). Do not assume Git metadata alone is a reconstructible binary.
working_method.branch_and_git: Sync lightweight changed source/checkpoints once per validated stage/milestone as required by active GIT-SYNC-POLICY and MEM-006; no per-card commits, large binary Git payloads or per-edit ZIPs.
working_method.library: Do not upload intermediate bulky archives solely to number revisions; do not delete or overwrite prior unique library artifacts without separate exact lineage, hash, and recoverability verification.
meaningful_snapshot_triggers: new canonical authority / irreversible content transformation
complete validated stage or major source batch
required immutable baseline at a formal audit gate
final delivery and exact-runtime integration when applicable
user explicitly requests a portable checkpoint
working_method.final_delivery: Preserve existing complete organized one-ZIP production handoff and all official v3.3.6 gates for vocabulary; other nonlexical streams retain their own final contracts.

explicit_exceptions.nvv_final_audit: The currently recorded immutable post-S9 audit baseline MUST stay frozen while the full 2492-target audit proceeds. Findings are recorded separately; after completion apply the approved repairs as one bounded successor, as required by active MEM-NVV-003. Never silently edit the audit baseline.
explicit_exceptions.nvv_shards: Respect active NVV continuous_safe per-shard lightweight resume state and milestone checkpoints; do not replace it with one monolithic mutable archive.
explicit_exceptions.source_and_learner_data: Original registered source bytes and historically LOCKED packages are immutable; 'edit directly' refers to the new working content state, not rewriting evidence.
explicit_exceptions.content_stage_gates: Stage4 qualified independent linguistic signoff, Stage5 clean delivery anti-bypass, and Stage6/7 exact CURRENT runtime tests remain mandatory when applicable. No false PASS/FINAL claims.
explicit_exceptions.grammar_reading_writing: Content can use lean WIP persistence, but do not substitute lexical TSV or vocabulary-specific final packaging for a source-specific final schema.
explicit_exceptions.app_runtime: This policy does not change app runtime release packaging, pinned CURRENT/LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED semantics, storage migrations, UI approvals, or runtime acceptance.
